member.name: T:ZeroAlloc.ZA
member.summary: Per-assembly zero-allocation API surface. The generator adds overloads in this compilation. Thread-safety: static methods use per-thread buffers via ; do not hold a or across await on the same thread while nested calls run.
Generated zero-allocation formatting methods.

remarks.para: All methods return or which MUST be disposed using a using statement.
Default buffer size: 2.097.152 bytes (configurable via ZeroAlloc_DefaultBufferSize MSBuild property).
Recursive heap fallback: enabled (configurable via ZeroAlloc_RecursiveHeapFallback MSBuild property).
Buffer overflow behavior: Grow (configurable via ZeroAlloc_BufferOverflowBehavior MSBuild property).

member.name: F:ZeroAlloc.ZA.DefaultBufferSize
member.summary: Initial buffer size for ThreadStatic buffers. Configured via ZeroAlloc_DefaultBufferSize MSBuild property.

member.name: F:ZeroAlloc.ZA.RecursiveHeapFallback
member.summary: Whether to fall back to heap allocation when the ThreadStatic buffer is already in use (nested/recursive call). Configured via ZeroAlloc_RecursiveHeapFallback MSBuild property.

remarks.para: IMPORTANT: Each thread has exactly ONE ThreadStatic buffer. If you call ZeroAlloc APIs while still holding a TempString/TempBytes (i.e., nested calls), the inner call cannot use the ThreadStatic buffer because the outer call is still using it.
When true: Inner calls allocate a temporary heap buffer (small allocation). When false: Inner calls throw InvalidOperationException.

member.name: F:ZeroAlloc.ZA.BufferOverflowBehavior
member.summary: Behavior when content exceeds buffer size: 0=Grow, 1=HeapFallback, 2=Throw. Configured via ZeroAlloc_BufferOverflowBehavior MSBuild property.
